messages:
Evan (sales): HarvestBank procurement just emailed asking for SOC2 Type II, ISO scope statement (if available), a named pen-test attestation, and confirmation of data residency during the 30-day POC. Need by Tue morning.
Maya (solutions): Quick scan: SOC2 we can provide. ISO scope we only have a scope statement (not certified). Pen-test attestation needs legal sign + vendor summary.
Diego (security): I'll export SOC2 Type II PDF and controls matrix today. For pen-test: vendor did app+infra test Q2-2025, no crits, two highs remediated. I can prepare a vendor-backed summary.
Clara (legal): I can sign an attestation letter addressed to HarvestBank Procurement, but need the vendor summary as backup. Also confirm recipient email. Keep wording factual only.
Omar (eng): For data residency: we can pin POC infra to us-east-1 for 30 days. Ops needs ticket but it's doable. If they want EU region, that takes a day to provision.
Evan (sales): Recipient: procurement@harvestbank.com (Attn: Joel Park). Tell them us-east-1 is available now, eu-west-1 needs 24h.
Maya (solutions): Owners and ETA: Diego: SOC2 + controls matrix by EOD. Diego: pen-test summary by Mon 10:00. Omar: region pin confirmation by Mon 16:00. Clara: draft letter Mon AM, sign Mon PM. Evan: send link and log in CRM.
Diego (security): Note: vendor raw report cannot be shared per contract; will attach vendor summary + vendor contact for verification.
Clara (legal): Include this sentence in letter: "This attestation is provided solely for the benefit of HarvestBank in connection with its evaluation of Redwood Inference and does not create any third-party rights."
doc-bot: Created share link: https://drive.redwood.com/harvest-poc-evidence (expires 7d).
Evan (sales): I'll message Joel: "We can provide SOC2, pen-test attestation, and confirm data residency. Target delivery Mon COB. Is that timeline ok?"
Maya (solutions): Also add an artifact-version note in the SOW so future asks reference the delivered package date.
Omar (eng): Added ops ticket #OP-7421 for region pin; will attach deploy logs if they ask for remediation evidence.
Diego (security): Uploading SOC2 & pen-test summary now to the draft folder.
Evan (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll wait for the signed letter then send the package. Closing after share + CRM update.
